description: The PO revisions state different quantities, Ready By deadlines, and delivery windows.
resolution: Rev 2 was later transmitted through VendorLink and is the latest authorized revision; it controls.

description: A copied-forward buyer planning row still shows Rev 1's 800 units and September 15 Ready By date.
resolution: The planning sheet explicitly is not a PO system of record; authorized Rev 2 controls.

description: The tendered pickup window differs from actual carrier arrival and departure milestones.
resolution: The carrier incident and pickup confirmation establish the actual delayed milestones and assign the operational cause to the Northstar-designated carrier.

description: The preliminary export reports zero on-time units based on destination arrival, while the managed-pickup records show 900 compliant units ready before the deadline.
resolution: Northstar policy measures managed-pickup timeliness at compliant Ready By; correct raw on-time units are 900, not zero.

description: The vendor requests removal of the whole OTIF miss, but ASN and receiving evidence show only 900 of 1,000 units were tendered and received.
resolution: The carrier evidence supports only the transportation-timing component; the 100-unit vendor shortage remains in the performance result.
